content_of_post_to_answer: What is one habit you genuinely stuck with that helped you get more done?
answer: A habit that changed my productivity was separating “thinking work” from “doing work.” I used to mix planning, researching, and executing, which made every task feel heavier than it was. Giving each type of work its own space reduced friction and made starting easier. The overlooked benefit of a good habit is not just that it saves time; it removes the small decisions that quietly drain attention. The best routines protect your focus before you need it.
